original_value: The state parameters of electrical equipment and power system control parameters are the key data to realize the precise control and cooperative autonomy of a cyber physical power system. The trustworthiness of the data is the primary condition to guarantee the electric power system’s safe and reliable operation. In the traditional centralized data acquisition and management architecture, the security and trustworthiness completely depend on the central main server. A small mistake in the main server will result in data loss, which is irreversible and fatal. Blockchain technique combines the dispersed data with mutual backup and retrieval mechanism, which guarantees that the data cannot be tampered with and forged privately. Based on the blockchain technology, this article proposes a novel data trustworthy acquisition model with high credibility, applied to a self-organized cyber physical power system. In order to overcome the long time-consuming process of building traditional blockchains, a new on-demand data transmission routing algorithm with M/M/1/k queuing model is proposed in this article. Different scales of IEEE standard bus systems are employed as experimental examples to evaluate the algorithm’s performance. The results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively shorten the time consumption of blockchain construction and realize the data trustworthiness of cyber physical power system.

result.paraphrase: State parameters of electrical equipment and control parameters for power systems are essential data for achieving precise control and coordinated autonomy in a cyber-physical power system. Data trustworthiness is the primary prerequisite for ensuring safe and reliable operation of the electric power system. Under the conventional centralized data acquisition and management architecture, security and trustworthiness depend entirely on the central main server; a minor error in that server can cause irreversible and fatal data loss. By integrating distributed data with mutual backup and retrieval mechanisms, blockchain technology ensures data cannot be privately tampered with or forged. On this basis, this article proposes a new highly credible trustworthy data acquisition model for a self-organized cyber-physical power system. To address the lengthy process of constructing traditional blockchains, the article also presents an on-demand data transmission routing algorithm based on an M/M/1/k queuing model. Experimental evaluation is conducted using IEEE standard bus systems of different scales. The results indicate that the proposed algorithm can effectively reduce blockchain construction time and achieve data trustworthiness in the cyber-physical power system.
